Supported GPUs · Benchmarks · Install · FAQ · Support

NVIDIA ships GeForce cards with their tensor cores capped to half speed for FP16, BF16 and TF32 math with FP32 accumulation, which is what nearly all AI training and unquantized inference uses. items.name: pngdeer
items.description: Smaller PNGs, same picture. Lossy PNG compression that picks the quality for you: 8–12% smaller than TinyPNG at the same quality. Command line and in the browser.

readme.excerpt:
Smaller PNGs. Same picture. pngdeer is a lossy PNG compressor with no quality slider: for each image it searches palette sizes from 2 to 256 colors, with and without dithering, scores each result with a perceptual metric, and keeps the smallest file that still looks right. At the same quality, the median image comes out 8–12% smaller than with TinyPNG , the best result of any open-source compressor we've measured.

Try it in your browser → Nothing is uploaded: images are compressed on your device.

brew install heydeer/tap/pngdeer pngdeer input.png -o output.png
features: Picks the quality for you : about what TinyPNG would give the image, never above 90 on SSIMULACRA2's scale, which is indistinguishable at 1:
Same bytes everywhere : the command line (macOS and Linux) and the browser (WebAssembly, on every core) run the same Rust code and write ide
Big images too : up to 40 megapixels in the browser, more on the command line.
Animated PNGs stay animated : every frame on one palette and at the target quality, timing kept; 28% of the original size on 12 animated emo
Free and open source : MIT.
Points : median SSIMULACRA2 points above (+) or below (−) TinyPNG when a tool's file is as big as TinyPNG's.
Reaches : images where a tool can match TinyPNG's quality at all.
Held out : pngdeer's parameters were tuned on the 109 images; the other 71 were collected afterwards and never used for tuning.

items.name: dashboard-design-skill
items.description: A Claude Code skill for clean, honest dashboard UI: KPI tiles, charts, date pickers, ranked lists, states, layouts and a screenshot QA pass. Distilled from 127 shipped dashboards.

readme.excerpt:
Give your coding agent the taste of a senior product designer for data screens, on the web or in SwiftUI. This skill teaches it to build, redesign and critique analytics, revenue, metrics and admin dashboards: KPI cards, charts, heatmaps, bullet graphs, comparison periods, ranked breakdowns, date range pickers, filters, empty states, wide and phone layouts. Pages that speak for themselves : numbers and shapes on the screen, every explanation in a tooltip. It ends every job with a screenshot QA pass, so it judges what is on the screen rather than what is in the code.

It was distilled from 127 shipped dashboard screens (analytics tools, revenue dashboards, design systems, design galleries), the field's classics ( Stephen Few, Edward Tufte, Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic, Cleveland & McGill, Nielsen Norman Group , the WCAG), six of Apple's WWDC sessions on charts, chart accessibility and interface writing, two full teardowns, and real redesigns where every rule here was broken once, caught on a screenshot, and fixed.

- Wordless : a sentence under every KPI and a row of "insights" sentences are gone. Numbers, shapes and one-word baselines on the screen; explanations in tooltips. The QA pass counts sentences; the target is zero. - Monitor : overview → what needs attention → closer look → act. Problems are flagged on the data itself, and the action sits on the flag (a not-marked heatmap cell is the remind button). - Perception reference : the encoding ladder, Few's colour rules, sequent

items.name: Terrascope
items.description: Braille-rendered terminal world map with live weather, aircraft, earthquakes, and day/night layers.

readme.excerpt:
terrascope is an interactive world map for the terminal. It renders countries, place names, live aircraft, city weather, a radar overlay, earthquakes, and day/night bands with curses , Unicode Braille cells, and terminal colors.

The app is intentionally lightweight at install time. Large map data is downloaded into a user cache the first time it is needed, then reused on later runs.

Country names and abbreviations, plus airport names and locations, are bundled from Natural Earth so they are available offline without a first-run download.

items.name: ente
items.description: 💚 End-to-end encrypted cloud for everything.

readme.excerpt:
Fully open source end-to-end encrypted photos, authenticators and more.

Ente is a service that provides a fully open source, end-to-end encrypted platform for you to store your data in the cloud without needing to trust the service provider. On top of this platform, we have built three apps so far: Ente Photos (an alternative to Apple and Google Photos), Ente Locker (a safe space for your most important documents and credentials), and Ente Auth (a 2FA alternative to the deprecated Authy).

This monorepo contains all our source code - the client apps (iOS / Android / F-Droid / Web / Linux / macOS / Windows) for both the products (and more planned future ones!), and the server that powers them.
